_comment: CVSS 3.0 reference vectors for the score-compute engine. Base scores of the capture cases are the values NVD reports in a real Grype 0.121.3 scan of debian:12 (hdf-converters/converters/grype-to-hdf fixtures, debian@sha256:366a6da5...); every case's base and temporal values were also computed by pandatix/go-cvss v0.6.4 (MIT), used as an independent oracle and not as a dependency, and agree. Equations: FIRST CVSS v3.0 specification section 8 (https://www.first.org/cvss/v3.0/specification-document). Shared by go/cvss_test.go and test/cvss.test.ts.
